sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You emphasise proving your reliability, yet your proposed quality commitment allows more defects than your recorded performance—it seems you want to build confidence without overcommitting. We want a dependable partnership grounded in measurable defect reduction and proportionate accountability. How will you substantiate a tighter, binding quality commitment with a full root-cause and corrective-action report?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). We understand cash flow matters to you: we will pay every invoice reliably on the agreed day. Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (800 ppm, EUR 150 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit; 300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hello,
many thanks, good to have your reply!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
Please let me explain.
We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
Thanks for the promise to pay on time, that really helps us out!
We can accept the EUR 150 chargeback, but let's be realistic and set the ppm to 2500 based on the actual records you mentioned.
With that sorted, I can drop the price to EUR 46.00 per unit.
Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm and a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint: €46.00 per unit.
We are ready when you are!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
